complaint_text: Well-designed tactile walkway at Swargate underground Metro station.
PMPML bus stand at Bhosari has water puddles and no paved walking path for commuters.
Is the daily ₹50 pass valid on both PMPML regular buses and electric AC buses?
Driver deliberately cut across three lanes near Nal Stop junction, causing panic among passengers.
What is the current operational schedule of late evening buses from Pune Station to Kondhwa?
Broken sharp metal edge protruding from seat handle cut a passenger's arm near Chandani Chowk.
Driver waited an extra minute so a running commuter could catch the morning Metro feeder bus.
Students forced to stand on footboard on route 103 due to lack of extra buses during school hours.
Metro feeder bus departed immediately as commuters exited Bhosari station. Well synchronized.
Why did route 114 terminate at Katraj bypass instead of completing full route to Gujar Nimbalkarwadi?
Conductor spoke politely and returned accurate change to all passengers without any fuss.
Seats in the newly inducted electric bus were comfortable and the interior was clean and fresh.
Smooth ticketing via PMPML e-ticketing mobile app. Conductor verified digital ticket promptly.
Rainbow BRTS lane barriers near Swargate broken, private two-wheelers and autos blocking bus passage.
Conductor refused to give ticket to passenger paying via UPI stating QR machine battery was dead.
Conductor charged ₹25 instead of regular ₹15 fare between Deccan and Katraj, claiming revised fare without receipt.
Waited 40 mins at Katraj bus terminal for route 298. Staff says three buses skipped their trip today.
Bus suspension is totally worn out, every small pothole on Sinhagad road feels like an earthquake.
Smooth feeder service connecting PCMC metro station to auto cluster IT offices.
Route 158 from Manapa to Vadgaon Sheri is always missing during morning office rush hours.
PMPML bus depot staff in Kothrud washed and sanitized buses before early morning dispatch.
Conductor on bus MH-12-PQ-9912 was extremely rude and pushed student showing valid PMPML monthly pass.
Driver refused to stop at the designated stop at Kothrud Stand and sped past despite passengers waving.
Metro train was comfortably spaced and security guard ensured orderly boarding inside women's coach.
Clear route map displayed on board at Vishrantwadi terminal made bus change very simple.
Pregnant lady forced to stand for 45 minutes on route 170 because youth refused to vacate reserved seat.
No priority boarding given to mothers with infants at crowded Katraj bus stop during rush hour.
Driver stopped slightly ahead of the zebra crossing but was otherwise polite and drove fine.
Elderly passenger fell due to heavy push from crowd rushing inside bus at Pune Station depot.
Newly paved smooth BRTS lane on Alandi road has reduced travel time significantly. Good initiative.
Clear bilingual Marathi and English signage installed across all Pune Metro interchange stations.
Bus frequency between Baner and Pune University has improved noticeably this week. Good job.
Passengers crushed against closing doors of overcrowded bus at Alandi depot.
The driver was smoking bidi inside the bus cabin while halted at Wagholi terminal.
Metro elevator at Shivaji Nagar station was functional and helped disabled passenger reach concourse easily.
Are cleaning schedules published for PMPML depots in Pune?
Bus interior was completely dirty with garbage, gutkha stains on floor and torn seat cushions.
Driver patiently waited for a physically challenged passenger to comfortably sit before starting bus.
Rainwater leaking heavily from roof of PMPML bus onto passengers during Pune monsoon downpour.
Waited 1 hour 15 mins for bus 144 on Sinhagad road. School children were stranded in the evening.
Driver took a sharp turn without indicator, almost colliding with a PMPML bus on adjacent lane.
Metro automated ticket vending machine at Civil Court swallowed ₹100 note without issuing ticket.
